description.value: Hyatt House New York/Chelsea is an extended-stay hotel at 815 Avenue of the Americas in Chelsea. Hyatt's facility guide lists apartment-style Kitchen Suites, a Convenient 24/7 H Market and a 24/7 Fitness Room. It also offers Pet-friendly accommodations, which helps on a longer family stay. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “Love the breakfast. All the staffs are friendly”; “Very convenient location if you come with family, as there is a kitchen”. Representative watch-outs: “Nobody helped us with our luggage either upon check-in or check-out”; “I wish there were more vegetables for breakfast”.
